content.value: An 80 cm high fish tank of cross-section 2 m x 0.6 m is partially filled water and is to be transported on the back of a truck. The truck accelerates from O to 98 km/h in 10 sec. If it is desired that no water spills during acceleration, determine the allowable initial water height in the tank. Would you recommend the tank to be aligned with the long or short side parallel to the direction of motion?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2021
